units.source_text: 薰中纳言想起新年里事绪纷忙，不会有工夫访问宇治，便在年底来到山庄。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, thought that the New Year would be crowded with affairs and that he would have no time to visit Uji, so he came to the mountain villa at the end of the year.

units.source_text: 路上积雪甚深，普通行人也不见一个，薰中纳言却不惜千金之体，冒雪入山访问。

en.t: The snow lay very deep on the road, and not a single ordinary traveler could be seen, yet Kaoru spared no regard for his noble person and went into the mountains through the snow to visit them.

units.source_text: 其关怀之深切，使两女公子衷心感激，因此对待他比往常亲切：

en.t: The depth of his concern moved the two young ladies from the heart, and so they treated him more warmly than usual:

units.source_text: 命侍女为他特设雅洁座位，又命把藏着的、未染黑的火缽取出，把灰尘拂拭干净，供客人使用。

en.t: They ordered the waiting women to prepare a specially elegant and clean seat for him, and also had the stored, unblackened brazier brought out, wiped free of dust, and set for the guest to use.

units.source_text: 众侍女回想起亲王在日对薰君欢迎之状，想与共话旧事。

en.t: The waiting women remembered how warmly the prince had welcomed Lord Kaoru while he was alive, and they wished to talk with him about old times.

units.source_text: 大女公子总觉得不好意思和他会面，但恐对方怪她不识好歹，只得勉强出来相见。

en.t: The elder princess still felt embarrassed about meeting him, but fearing that he would think her ungrateful, she forced herself to come out and see him.

units.source_text: 虽然还是十分拘束，但说话比从前多，亲疏恰到好处，态度温和优雅。

en.t: Although she was still very reserved, she spoke more than before, kept exactly the right balance of intimacy and distance, and was gentle and graceful in manner.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言意犹未尽，觉得总不能永远如此疏远。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was still not satisfied and felt that they could not remain so distant forever.

units.source_text: 但又想道：“这真是一时的冲动了。

en.t: But then he thought, "This truly must be a passing impulse.

units.source_text: 人心毕竟是容易动摇的。”

en.t: After all, the human heart is easily swayed."

units.source_text: 便对大女公子说道：“匂亲王非常恨我呢。

en.t: Then he said to the elder princess, "Prince Niou is very angry with me.

units.source_text: 也许是由于我在谈话中乘便把尊大人对我的恳切的遗言向他泄露了之故。

en.t: Perhaps it is because, in conversation, I happened to reveal to him your late father's earnest final words to me.

units.source_text: 或者是由于此人十分敏感，善于推量人心之故，他屡次埋怨我道：‘我指望你在小姐面前替我吹嘘。

en.t: Or perhaps because he is extremely sensitive and skilled at reading people's hearts, he has repeatedly complained to me, 'I counted on you to speak well of me before the young lady.

units.source_text: 如今小姐对我如此冷淡，定然是你说了我的坏话。’

en.t: Now that she is so cold to me, you must certainly have spoken ill of me.'

units.source_text: 这实在是我所意想不到之事。

en.t: This is truly something I never expected.

units.source_text: 只因他上次来游宇治，是由我引导的，故我未便断然相拒。

en.t: Only because I guided him when he last came to visit Uji, I could not very well refuse him outright.

units.source_text: 但不知小姐对他为何如此冷淡？

en.t: But I do not know why the young lady is so cold toward him.

units.source_text: 世人都说匂亲王好色，其实全是谣传。

en.t: People all say that Prince Niou is amorous, but in truth it is nothing but rumor.

units.source_text: 此人用心异常深远。

en.t: His feelings are unusually deep and far-reaching.

units.source_text: 我只听见有些女人听了他的几句戏言，立刻轻率地服从他。

en.t: I have only heard that some women, after hearing a few playful words from him, at once submitted to him frivolously.

units.source_text: 他认为此种女人毫不足取，便不睬她们。

en.t: He regards such women as not worth considering and pays them no attention.

units.source_text: 谣传恐是由此而起的吧。

en.t: The rumors probably arose from that.

units.source_text: 世间有一种男子，凡事随缘，心无定见。

en.t: There are men in the world who leave everything to circumstance and have no fixed mind of their own.

units.source_text: 处世落拓不拘，一味迁就别人。

en.t: They live carelessly and unrestrainedly, always yielding to others.

units.source_text: 这样也好，那样也好。

en.t: This way is fine, and that way is fine as well.

units.source_text: 即使稍有不称心处，亦认为命该如此，无可奈何。

en.t: Even if something is slightly displeasing, they think it is simply fate and that nothing can be done.

units.source_text: 与此种男子结为夫妇，倒也有爱情恒久的。

en.t: When one becomes husband and wife with such a man, love may in fact last a long time.

units.source_text: 然而一旦感情破裂，便像龙田川的浊水一般流传恶名。

en.t: Yet once feelings break apart, a bad name spreads like the muddy waters of the Tatsuta River.

units.source_text: 以前的爱情消失得影迹全无。

en.t: The former love disappears without leaving the slightest trace.

units.source_text: 这也是世间常有之事。

en.t: This too is something often seen in the world.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王绝不是此种人。

en.t: But Prince Niou is certainly not that sort of person.

units.source_text: 他用心非常深远，只要是称他的心、和他趣味相左之处不多的人，他决不轻易抛弃，决不做有始无终之事。

en.t: His feelings are very deep, and if someone pleases his heart and does not differ much from his tastes, he will never cast that person aside lightly or begin something only to leave it unfinished.

units.source_text: 他的性情我很熟悉，别人所不知的我都知道。

en.t: I know his nature very well, and I know everything about him that others do not.

units.source_text: 如果你认为此人可取，愿意和他结缘，我一定竭诚效劳，玉成其事。

en.t: If you consider him worthy and are willing to form a bond with him, I will serve with all sincerity and bring the matter to completion.

units.source_text: 那时我将东奔西走，跑得两脚酸痛呢。”

en.t: At that time I shall run east and west until both my feet ache."

units.source_text: 他说时态度非常认真。

en.t: As he said this, his manner was extremely earnest.

units.source_text: 大女公子认为他所指的不是她自己而是妹妹，她只要以长姐代父母的身份作答。

en.t: The elder princess thought that he was referring not to herself but to her younger sister, and that she only needed to answer as an elder sister standing in place of their parents.

units.source_text: 但她左思右想，终觉得难于答复。

en.t: But after thinking it over from every side, she still found it difficult to answer.

units.source_text: 后来笑道：“叫我说什么好呢？

en.t: At last she smiled and said, "What should I say?

units.source_text: 恋慕的话讲得太多，更使我难于作答了。”

en.t: There has been so much talk of love that it makes it even harder for me to reply."

units.source_text: 措词温雅，姿态非常可爱。

en.t: Her words were refined and gentle, and her bearing was very charming.

units.source_text: 薰君又说：“适才我所说的，不一定是关于大小姐自身的事。

en.t: Lord Kaoru went on, "What I said just now was not necessarily about you yourself, my lady.

units.source_text: 但请大小姐以兄姐之心，体谅我今天踏雪远来的一片诚意。

en.t: But please, with the heart of an elder sibling, understand the sincerity with which I came so far today through the snow.

units.source_text: 匂亲王所属意的，似乎是二小姐。

en.t: The one Prince Niou seems to have set his heart on is the younger lady.

units.source_text: 听说他曾有信来，隐约提及此事。

en.t: I heard that he once sent a letter that hinted at this matter.

units.source_text: 但不知信是写给谁的？

en.t: But I do not know to whom the letter was written.

units.source_text: 又不知给他的回信是谁写的？”

en.t: Nor do I know who wrote the reply to him."

units.source_text: 大女公子见他如此探问，想道：“幸而至今没有给匂亲王写过信。

en.t: When the elder princess saw him probing in this way, she thought, "Fortunately, I have never written a letter to Prince Niou up to now.

units.source_text: 如果当时戏耍，写过回信，虽然无伤大雅，但他说这种话，教我多么害羞，好难过啊！”

en.t: If I had written a playful reply at the time, even though it would have done no real harm, hearing him say such things would make me so ashamed and distressed."

units.source_text: 便默默不答，但取笔写一首诗送给他。

en.t: So she remained silent and did not answer, but took up a brush and wrote a poem to give him.

units.source_text: 诗曰：

en.t: The poem said:
